resources.string: Enable or disable any app on the device. Tap a row to flip it — root does it instantly when available, otherwise it taps through Settings for you.
Toolbox taps the Disable or Enable button in Settings for the apps you pick, so you can manage apps without ADB or root.
No root on this device? Turn on the Toolbox accessibility service and toggles will tap Disable / Enable in Settings for you instead. With root, this step is not needed.
Nothing toggled yet — tap a row to enable or disable an app.
